title: Tour Guide menu (payload of the `menu` envelope)
description: A menu check for one restaurant: the dishes the party can eat and the ones to ask about, read from the restaurant's own menu and dated (Contract C16, helpers/prompts/TG-PHASE-16.md WP-16b). `checked`, `fits` and `note` are the place's facts.menu. Own data only: our words, place ids, names, the menu's own dish names and prices, and links; every object refuses unknown keys, so no Google field fits. Both validators (gas/44_menu.js tgEnvValidateMenu, packs/tour-guide/menu/menu-payload.mjs validateMenuPayload) also refuse a Google field by name anywhere, and check what this subset cannot say: `ask` exactly on the dishes whose `fits` is `ask`, at least one source unless `fits` is `unknown`, dates real calendar dates, the whole payload at most 12 000 characters.

id.description: mn-, the run's local date, -, the place's slug. A re-delivered id replaces its row.

date.description: The planned day the check was asked for.

checked.description: The day the menu was read; the fact's `checked`.

diet.description: The party's limits in plain words.

dishes.description: In menuPayload's order: course, then yes before ask, then the menu's order.

others.description: Dishes on the menu that do not fit (or did not make the twelve).

sources.description: The restaurant's own pages the dishes came from; at least one unless `fits` is `unknown` (the validators).

ask.description: What to ask the staff; exactly when `fits` is `ask` (the validators).
